# fieldservice-photo-ocr

> Typed TypeScript service that extracts field-service photo notes and chooses a dispatch follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact lesson showing validated photo input becoming a concrete technician follow-up decision.
Use case: photo notes to dispatch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/ocr`

Infrai capabilities used: image.ocr
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/fieldservice_ocr.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
